title: Juniper and the Salt
premise: Astrid Okafor steals memories for coin in the Salt Valley, the one place where magic cannot follow — which is why she never leaves. When a mute child arrives speaking a dead tongue, Astrid discovers the boy carries the stolen mind of King Aldric, whose crown has been possessed by an ancient entity called the Salt that feeds on oaths of loyalty. To free the king, Astrid must return what she has stolen, including her own buried past as the daughter of the last royal memory-keeper, and choose between the man who raised her and the truth he hid. In the end she unbinds Aldric by sacrificing her own stolen memories, leaving her identity blank but her heart intact, and the valley's magicless sanctuary falls so magic and mortals must finally share one world.
about_author: Ivo Marchetti is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing letters no one ever claimed. Juniper and the Salt is their second novel, written in rented rooms along the Ligurian coast.

chapters.title: The Weight of Borrowed Years
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. She lifts a widow's grief from her head for a paying client, showing how memory-theft works and why she stays in the magicless valley. Emotional beat: competence masking loneliness; she can hold anyone's past but owns almost none of her own.

chapters.title: Knocking at the Door of Nowhere
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. A mud-caked child appears at her cottage during a salt storm, speaking a language older than any kingdom — yet Astrid understands it, to her own horror. Emotional beat: dread and reluctant tenderness as she takes him in.

chapters.title: What the Valley Cannot Hold
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The boy, Juniper, sleeps and dreams aloud; his dreams leak images of a crowned man drowning in white. Astrid realizes magic is circling the valley's borders like wolves. Emotional beat: the sanctuary she trusted begins to feel like a cage.

chapters.title: The Man Who Raised a Thief
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, flashback-woven. She seeks out Corvin, her mentor, who taught her theft and forbade questions about her childhood. He recognizes Juniper's language and goes pale. Emotional beat: first crack in her loyalty — Corvin is lying about something fundamental.

chapters.title: Salt on the Crown
chapters.summary: Juniper's dream-POV, rendered through Astrid touching his brow. We see King Aldric alive but entombed inside his own body while the Salt wears him, binding nobles with oaths it devours. Emotional beat: horror and pity; the enemy is revealed as hunger, not malice.

chapters.title: The Price of Leaving
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Crossing the valley border means magic can find her — and something already knows her name. She bargains with a smuggler, Wren, for passage. Emotional beat: fear sharpened into resolve; first spark of trust with a stranger.

chapters.title: Roads That Remember
chapters.summary: Astrid and Juniper travel with Wren; waystones whisper fragments of Astrid's erased childhood. She learns she was born outside the valley, a keeper's daughter. Emotional beat: vertigo of self-discovery; identity as something taken, not lost.

chapters.title: The Court of Hollow Faces
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. They reach the capital, where courtiers smile with oath-drained eyes. Astrid poses as a memory-broker to get close to the throne. Emotional beat: claustrophobic tension; everyone loyal is half-empty.

chapters.title: An Audience with the Thing
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Face to face with the crowned Salt, she feels it taste her memories and offer her anything — including her missing past — if she betrays Juniper. Emotional beat: temptation; the villain's seduction is comfort, not power.

chapters.title: Corvin's Confession
chapters.summary: Corvin's POV. He arrives at court, reveals he was the royal memory-keeper who erased Astrid's childhood to hide her from the Salt, which hunts keepers' bloodlines. Emotional beat: betrayal transmuted into protective love; loyalty vs. truth made flesh.

chapters.title: Juniper Speaks
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV, first time in his own voice. His old tongue breaks the Salt's hold briefly; he is Aldric's son, smuggled out with a fragment of his father's true mind. Emotional beat: the child becomes the key; hope with a deadline attached.

chapters.title: Oaths Devoured
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The Salt accelerates its feeding; whole regiments go hollow. Wren sacrifices their escape route to buy time. Emotional beat: mounting dread; the cost of every alliance becomes visible.

chapters.title: The Keeper's Vault
chapters.summary: Astrid and Corvin descend into the memory-vault beneath the palace where her erased childhood is stored in salt-glass. Emotional beat: trembling anticipation — she can take herself back, but opening the vault will alert the Salt.

chapters.title: What I Was Before
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. She reclaims her memories: her mother's death sealing the vault, the Salt's first rising, her father's bargain. Emotional beat: grief and wholeness colliding; she is more herself and more broken than ever.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Bargain
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Cornered by the Salt, Wren offers Astrid's location in exchange for his crew's minds — then secretly leaves a trail only she could read. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. survival; even betrayal carries a hidden fidelity.

chapters.title: Siege of the Empty
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The hollowed court turns on them; Corvin holds the stair and falls, buying Astrid and Juniper the way down to Aldric's buried body. Emotional beat: devastating loss; the mentor's lie was love all along.

chapters.title: The Drowned King
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. She finds Aldric's true self adrift in his own mind and learns unbinding requires a keeper to pour memories into the breach — all of hers, or the child's. Emotional beat: impossible choice distilled; love against duty at its sharpest.

chapters.title: Everything I Stole
chapters.summary: Climax, Astrid's POV. She refuses to sacrifice Juniper and instead pours in every memory she has ever stolen from others, plus her own reclaimed past, singing Juniper's dead language as the thread. Emotional beat: transcendence through surrender; identity given away freely.

chapters.title: The Crown Comes Off
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV, brief and disoriented. Freed, he severs the Salt's anchor by breaking his own coronation oath, collapsing its power over the court. Emotional beat: catharsis; the tyrant dies as a tired, grateful man.

chapters.title: Aftermath of White
chapters.summary: Juniper's POV. The Salt retreats into the earth, not destroyed but starved; the valley's sanctuary dissolves, and magic spreads into the lowlands. Juniper grieves his father the king and keeps his father the fragment. Emotional beat: bittersweet victory; freedom has redrawn every map.

chapters.title: A Blank Page with Her Name On It
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Memoryless but loved, she rebuilds herself from other people's accounts — Wren's stories, Juniper's songs, Corvin's letters. Emotional beat: quiet wonder; identity as chosen rather than remembered.

chapters.title: Where the River Meets the Sea
chapters.summary: Astrid and Juniper leave together for the coast, salt at their backs, magic ahead. Final image: she writes her own first new memory in a journal titled with her mother's word for 'keeper.' Emotional beat: hopeful open ending; love persists without proof.
